home.text: Engineered structural silhouettes crafted in dense 500GSM organic French Terry. Built thick, structured perfectly, designed timelessly.
Heavy loopback structured boxy silhouette hoodie accented with industrial tonal detailing. 500GSM French Terry — the heaviest in our collection.
"We do not create basic clothing — every loop stitch profile is calculation-driven."

{brand} functions independently at the intersection of performance apparel design frameworks and clean industrial aesthetics. Our products are entirely manufactured from local sustainable mills utilizing bespoke combed organic cotton systems.
"Full-grain hides that retain their natural strength — no compromise."
Our materials undergo deep processing in certified local facilities. The result is a fabric that maintains its structural signature under heavy use, developing rich character over time.
"The heaviest hoodie I've ever owned. The quality is unmatched — you can feel the difference the moment you put it on."
"Perfect oversized fit. The 500GSM fabric is substantial without being stiff. It drapes beautifully."
"I've been searching for the perfect hoodie for years. This is it. Worth every penny."
Built to last. We stand behind every hoodie.
Love it or return it — no questions

Grams Per Square Meter (GSM) quantifies structural material density. Traditional hoodies sit around 280GSM. Our 500GSM provides an incredibly structured, luxury drape while remaining highly breathable.
How do I wash my hoodie?
Wash inside-out on gentle cold cycles with similar colors. Hang dry or lay flat. Avoid high-heat machine drying to preserve the fabric structure.
Yes. To avoid textile overproduction, our hoodies drop within verified numbered limits. Once a color variant sells out, it will not be reproduced.
